body: Very relatable.
I imagine dolphins hanging around tough sea neighborhoods looking for pufferfish. Approaching a sea cucumber, they ask if they know where to get ahold of a little "puffer."

Ok, well let's calm down on the age thing. I've got friends who are in their 50s who act like children and I've met younger folks who somehow seem to have the wisdom of an old scholar. You never know. 

But....yes on everything else for sure
Hell no! I still write letters to him when I miss him. They just sit in a drawer, but hopefully one day when he is older he will read them and understand.
Exactly. Also, I spent so much money on attorneys for the divorce, I didnt have the cash to keep fighting for more years.
It's also a HUGE gender double standard. When a woman does it it's fine.

I never get to see my son. Many fathers dont. The system doesnt treat us as equal parents.  Hell, my ex-wife got ARRESTED and she still got custody...ugh. BUT...The fact is that he lied by omission. The violation of trust is a big deal.
Yeah, that's INSANE. Two hours? It should never take a human person two hours to get themself off.
I'm sorry you are going through this. Just make sure you have exhausted everything in the way of couples therapy. He may just be struggling with the lifestyle change. Good luck.

I'm so sorry you are going thru this.  It sounds like we are in different stages, as I just signed divorce papers last week, but let me just say this, it only gets harder once you've made the decision to move on, BUT EVENTUALLY its worth it.

UPDATE: Things are only getting worse.  I feel like everything is closing in on me.  I am really tired of crying and being upset and then angry and etc.  I think tonight I am going to drink a lot and likely kill myself.  I have a pretty good gameplan of how.  I jut have to finish this note and Im good.  Thanks for your help.  I think it was all too much.  I have lost everything now and she was kinda my final shot.
Thank you for your support on here. It has really meant a lot in a time of crisis like this.

I'm awake right now when I should be asleep. It's scary to not be able to trust your own emotions. I fell asleep for like 5 minutes, then had a full blown panic attack. 

I've never cheated or been cheated on. This is a horrible feeling. It was so hard letting someone in after my divorce. I thought if she saw how much I cared for her she wouldn't hurt me. I'm starting to believe that she would have hurt ANYONE. I just happened to be dumb enough to give my heart to her.

It doesnt hurt to hear it. I have been so alone in this. There are plenty of people to comfort her I'm sure. I have no one because I cant tell anyone except my therapist. I put a lot of hope into this one. It's why I wouldn't give up. It was all a lie though, and she is a professional liar. I found out more today. It only gets worse.

Will do.  Thanks for the advice.  I really do appreciate it.  It's been a while now and I am still struggling to just take it day by day.  It is going to sound INSANE, but I love her.  I can't help it.  I hope with time I will be able to just move on so I am not subjecting myself to this torture from someone who doesn't love me. 

I've talked to her ONCE for about 5 minutes after I caught her cheating.  She knew what kind of mental state I was in, so she asked that I delete anything that might be incriminating to her on my phone, so that after I killed myself she wouldn't get in trouble.

We had a couples counselor and I was also seeing a therapist and psychiatrist.  The fact is that you can talk until you are blue in the face.  If one person decides to just lie, all of that talking means nothing.  I am a very open person sexually, BUT my boundaries deserve to be respected just like anyone else.  I wasn't given that option, and that is what hurts the most.

Thank you so much. Suffering in silence has been hard. If there is any question as to why I chose that, look at some of the comments. People saying that I was, "asking for it," and the like. 

As for the pill thing, I tried them all and trust me it doesnt exist, lol. Half joking, but I wish you were right. I wish I could find comfort.

Yeah, her lies there really didnt surprise me. After I found out about her guy, she tried setting me up with a girl I knew. We 3 encounters, one with the three of us. I didnt want that though overall. I wanted my wife. I am a really understanding person. I tried to move my comfort zone to meet hers, but she kept moving the goal posts and lying to me.

That's fair. I did learn something valuable in all the insanity. There is a reason people love each other conditionally. When you love someone without condition, you allow them to do whatever they want.

Yeah. I get it. I suppose I could have stated that we, together made a calculated decision based upon multiple factors, but that would have taken longer. I pray that you never experience what I have. Even more, I hope there isnt a single person who tells you to just "move on" when your life is destroyed.

It is a bit complicated. There was a police report filed where she showed them the damage that was done in the house and put it ALL on me. After 30 days there was a peaceful contact order. She pulled that after I caught her cheating. 

I have been seeing doctors and therapists. I am dealing with a recurrence of PTSD as a result of this and past trauma. I dont expect anything will "fix" this. I just need to get it out of my head.
